audience: site owners and platform engineers who check zones, DNS records and Workers in Cloudflare

useCases.title: Find DNS records and their TTLs
useCases.text: List the zones of the token with their status and plan. List the DNS records of one zone, filtered by type or name, with their TTL and proxy state.

useCases.title: List Workers, KV and R2 resources
useCases.text: List the Worker scripts of an account with their last change time. List its KV namespaces and R2 buckets.

useCases.title: Review audit log entries and account members
useCases.text: List the audit log entries with a time range and actor filters. List the account members with their roles.

useCases.title: Add a DNS record to a zone
useCases.text: Create a DNS record in a zone. The change is live, and visitors see it after the TTL.

useCases.title: Purge cached files after a release
useCases.text: Purge the cache of a zone, or only the listed URLs. Visitors then fetch fresh content from the origin.
